---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for NovaSync
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "feature-request"]
assignees: ""
---

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected, and how often does this come up? (e.g. "Groups with members in different countries can't split expenses in their local currency.")

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible — e.g. which endpoint(s) would need to change in `backend/routes/`, which controller would own the logic, and how it should affect the frontend in `frontend/assets/js/app.js`.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why is the proposed solution better?

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references here.

## Priority

- [ ] Low — nice to have, no urgency
- [ ] Medium — would meaningfully improve the app
- [ ] High — addresses a significant gap or pain point
